detail.longDescription:
Got LensorOS C++ Code running on @librecomputer@fosstodon.org La Frite aarch64 board!! 

Took me about six weeks working on it in my free time, but we've got an actual little hardware computer running our kernel in a higher half privileged execution environment...

Time to write a million drivers!! (GIC, timer, a scheduler around those, then a USB BOT via xHCI).

Stay tuned for DOOM!

#osdev #programming #lensoros
